answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital anchor for identity by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to participate in consensus. This mechanism ensures that creating a river of fake identities yields no marginal influence, as the cost of the violet-weighted stake is linearly proportional to the total network value. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to gain control, effectively pricing out Sybil actors who cannot afford the prohibitive economic burden of maintaining significant network stake.
